title: The Bold and the Beautiful Spoilers Thursday, July 30: Dylan Confesses Sleeping with Will, Infuriating Electra; Taylor Sees Finn's Resolve Toward Sheila Weakening - NewsBreak
text:
By CP Bialois ,
6 hours ago The Bold and the Beautiful spoilers for Thursday, July 30 reveals Melissa Dylan ( Sydney Bullock ) confesses sleeping with Will Spencer ( Crew Morrow ) to a shocked Electra Forrester ( Laneya Grace ).
Taylor Hayes ( Rebecca Budig ) will worry when she notices Finn Finnegan ( Tanner Novlan )’s resolve against Sheila Carter ( Kimberlin Brown ) weakening.
Key Highlights: Dylan’s confession shocks and enrages Electra. Taylor sees Finn’s resolve toward Sheila weakening.
Electra goes full Brooke The Bold and the Beautiful spoilers show Dylan won’t hold back and lie to Electra about anything, and that includes Will. With Electra suffering mini strokes to her ego, Dylan will finish her off when she confesses she slept with Will. Until now, Electra hoped Will would wait for her while she remained stagnant and moved on with RJ Forrester ( Brayan Nicoletti ) like her family wishes.
It’s only proper keeping it in the family.
Now that Dylan won’t cow before her, Electra won’t know what to do. She’s started to turn to the dark side bit by bit, but now she’ll go all in. She’ll feel she always knew Dylan would betray her and she’ll lash out. Dylan will point out she dumped Will and told him they were never getting back together, but Electra won’t care. She’s unwilling to follow her heart and listens to everyone who has no say over her life, and that will be Dylan and Will’s fault.
Like her character archetype, Brooke Logan ( Katherine Kelly Lang ), she’ll go full Brooke 2.0 and wrap herself in the blanket of victimhood. The sad part is, she is a victim. She’s a victim of lazy writing keeping her in the mindset of a young teenager. She’s an adult, and maybe this will help her character grow some.
JPI Studios Taylor’s fear comes true Finn hasn’t hidden that he supports giving Sheila another chance and allow her into his family. He’s chosen to stand by Steffy Forrester ( Jacqueline MacInnes Wood ), but for how long?
That’s something Taylor will wonder and worry about when she sees how he’s weakening in his resolve. He wants to help his mother instead of coldly toss her to the wolves. Everyone’s concern is legitimate given Sheila’s past. Of course, Taylor choosing to steal her husband, who Sheila loves more than anyone is the driving force behind her paranoia. If anything, Taylor should encourage letting Sheila back in to protect herself and her family. Sheila has changed and is begging to be allowed in, but only Steffy stands in the way.
Will Dylan regret being honest with Electra? Let us know in the comments below.
